title: DCB, ENF and MMB structural cohesive verification family
purpose: Provide one software-neutral promotion ladder from local cohesive-law tests to structure-level Mode-I, Mode-II and mixed-mode delamination evidence.
physics: Fixed-path delamination under DCB Mode I, ENF Mode II and MMB mixed-mode loading

execution.evidence: The suite separates analytical oracles from an assembled Q1 bulk plus paired-facet DCB provider. It checks compliance-derived energy release, mandatory MMB mode partition, strict curve integrity, traceable external curve identity, and a three-or-more-level certificate spanning reference error, refinement change, process-zone resolution and artificial dissipation.

observables: Load and load-point displacement versus crack length.
Structural total, Mode-I and Mode-II energy-release rates from G=P^2/(2b)dC/da.
Source identity, curve coverage and convergence evidence.
Deterministic SHA-256 identities for the reference and every structural refinement curve.
acceptance: DCB and ENF analytical compliance derivatives recover their classical pure-mode energy-release formulas.
MMB cannot be reduced to scalar load/displacement data: a source-declared Mode-I partition is mandatory.
A computed curve covers the complete reference crack-length interval and meets a caller-declared relative tolerance.
The cohesive process zone contains at least three elements unless a stricter project threshold is declared.
Artificial dissipation remains at or below five percent of the declared physical internal-energy scale.
Structural promotion requires at least three successively refined curves, decreasing reference and inter-level errors, a bounded final refinement change, and a bounded Mode-I partition error.
External promotion additionally pins geometry, material, loading, contact, mesh and the exact source trace.
limitations: ASTM identifiers describe the specimen families; this software contract does not reproduce proprietary standards or imply certification.

The executable DCB provider is an isotropic structure-level verification rung with an intact cohesive tie and explicit precrack. Its first CI smoke test is not a completed DCB mesh/convergence certificate or propagation benchmark.
ENF and MMB do not yet have equivalent assembled providers.
MMB external curve execution and an independent cohesive finite-element comparison remain pending and are not labelled validated.
